src='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r if v!=0)
    border=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    centers=[(i,j,grid[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] not in (0,border)]
    cc=Counter(c for _,_,c in centers)
    common=cc.most_common(1)[0][0] if cc else None
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for c in set(cc)-{common}:
        pts=[(i,j) for i,j,v in centers if v==c]
        rows={}; cols={}
        for i,j in pts: rows.setdefault(i,[]).append(j); cols.setdefault(j,[]).append(i)
        for i,js in rows.items():
            if len(js)>=2:
                for j in range(min(js),max(js)+1):
                    if out[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=c
        for j,is_ in cols.items():
            if len(is_)>=2:
                for i in range(min(is_),max(is_)+1):
                    if out[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=c
    return out
'''
